checks.explanation: D-selection is on page 1 and itemized prices begin on page 1, so the disclosure is on the same page as the prices it accompanies.
The basic services includesText lists arrangements conference, shelter of remains, notices, permits and authorizations, and coordination with cemetery, crematory or third parties.
The list shows only the Basic Services of Funeral Director and Staff and Overhead as a mandatory overhead fee, with no additional mandatory facilities or handling fee.
D-embalming is on page 1 and the Embalming $795 price is on page 1, so they are on the same page.
No text states embalming is required for direct cremation, immediate burial, or closed-casket service; the only embalming language is the required disclosure.
D-alt-container is on page 2 and the Direct Cremation $1,595 to $1,945 range is on page 2, so they are on the same page.
Direct cremation is offered with purchaser-provided container, fiberboard container, and unfinished wood box options, with no statement that a casket is required.
The direct cremation description lists what is included and no crematory cash advance line is shown to create a double-count or ambiguity.
Forwarding, receiving, direct cremation and immediate burial all have their own priced lines, and no goods or services appear only inside a package or policy without a price.
The list contains only required single-price items like forwarding, receiving, direct cremation and immediate burial, and no optional combination package.
No text asserts a purchase is required by law, cemetery or crematory beyond the wording of the required disclosures themselves.
No text claims goods or services delay decomposition long-term or protect from gravesite substances.
No other wording undercuts a required disclosure, and the disclosures present use the expected wording.
